verdict.rationale: Pika documents many generative media tools, such as turning a premise into a script and storyboard or reframing clips with AI. None of them analyze a user's own data to surface insights or suggestions inside the product. The pricing card that fits a plan to the user's answers is an adjacent billing helper, not AI-generated insight from user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
